model.name: Abo2024 - whole-body fuel metabolism during exercise (female, relative intensity)

body.p: Kim, Saidel & Cabrera 2007 (Ann Biomed Eng 35:69, doi:10.1007/s10439-006-9201-x) as re-implemented by Abo, Casella & Layton 2024 (Bull Math Biol 86:17, doi:10.1007/s11538-023-01242-4), transcribed to SBML from github.com/Layton-Lab/Sex-Specific-Exercise-Model at commit 1536c28, female parameter set. Time in minutes, concentrations in mM, hormones in pM, fluxes in mmol/min. Exercise is a work rate WR (W) between tstart and tend; afterwards every exercise drive decays as exp(-(t - tend)/5), as in the source.
